How Honeybees Dance to Share Secret GPS Maps! — Honeybees cannot text directions—so they shake a figure-8 dance GPS inside the hive!
Kids science answer for "why bees do waggle dance for kids" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

Worker honeybees perform a figure-eight waggle dance whose angle to the sun and wiggle duration give hive mates exact flower directions.
